scenario_title: Session TTL typo, cache miss storm on the DB
title: Latency and timeouts on auth-svc

detection.alert: auth-svc: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on auth-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] auth-svc 2026-07-11 21:32-02:32: auth-svc: 343 of 484 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-07-11 21:32 and 2026-07-12 02:32 UTC (peak error ratio 0.94 vs baseline median 0.0). 3 error templates, 0 first seen in this span.

_templates.macro: Config change set {key} to {new} instead of {old}; almost every token check missed the Redis cache and hit meta-db, which saturated.
_templates.remediation: Revert {key} to {old} in {file}; add bounds validation for TTLs.

culprit.diff:
@@ -80,3 +80,3 @@ cache.session_ttl_s
 cache:
-  session_ttl_s: 3600
+  session_ttl_s: 36
   # managed by the platform team

rca.macro: Config change set cache.session_ttl_s to 36 instead of 3600; almost every token check missed the Redis cache and hit meta-db, which saturated.
rca.remediation: Revert cache.session_ttl_s to 3600 in config/auth-svc.yaml; add bounds validation for TTLs.

action_items: Add validation bounds and a canary for risky config keys (pool / timeout / retry / flags).
Alert on the error signature `{"level":"warn","msg":"session cache <*>`.
